scope: Historical post hoc diagnosis only; no test X, hidden Y, search, early stopping, adoption or submission
diagnostic_qualification: current price valid AND finite label; training diagnostic additionally restricted to actual training mask
interpretation: Any adjacent-prefix train MSE decline with validation MSE rise or validation IC decline is a descriptive signal; report all magnitudes without selecting tree counts. Annual/half-year signs, worst periods, all negative months and component conflicts are reported. Intervals condition on fixed predictions and cannot remove feature-selection bias.
interval_missing_rule: Jointly resample paired date rows in noncircular moving blocks; preserve each series' finite mask and calculate its own nanmean; retain precomputed turnover at all sampled dates, including block starts; no turnover recomputation. Final-score replicate is the weighted difference of separately averaged components.
